coverage_gaps: Integration tests: full order state machine transitions via HTTP
Frontend unit tests: cart Zustand store, order confirmation modal
E2E: full POS cashier flow — the single most important E2E test in the system

unit.description: create() returns order with status='pending', items=[], totalVnd=0, storeId from JWT
addItem() snapshots unitPriceVnd and taxRatePercent from product at add time — not live values (BR-ORDER-01)
addItem() recalculates totalVnd = sum(unitPriceVnd × quantity) after each item change (BR-ORDER-02)
addItem() to non-pending order returns 409 'Cannot modify a non-pending order'
addItem() with deactivated product returns 400 'Product is not active'
addItem() with same productId increments quantity (upsert), not duplicate row
confirmPayment() with no items returns 400 'Order has no items'
confirmPayment() transitions order pending → processing and emits order.processing event
cancel() transitions pending → cancelled; cancel on processing/completed → 409 'Cannot cancel order in current state'
findAll() with cashier user filters results to cashierId = caller.id only (BR-ORDER-08)

integration.description: POST /api/v1/orders → 201 pending; POST /orders/:id/items → 200 with updated totalVnd
POST /orders/:id/items → 404 cross-store product; → 400 deactivated product; → 409 non-pending order
POST /orders/:id/confirm-payment → 200, status='processing'; subsequent GET shows processing state
POST /orders/:id/confirm-payment with no items → 400; on already-processing order → 409
POST /orders/:id/cancel → 200 pending order; → 409 completed order; → 403 wrong store's cashier
GET /api/v1/orders → cashier sees own orders only; store-manager sees all store orders (BR-ORDER-08)
GET /api/v1/orders with status/date/cashierId filters — only returns matching orders

e2e.description: Cashier logs in → /pos → searches product → adds to cart → confirms payment → order.status='processing' → invoice number visible in UI
e2e.notes: This is the single most critical E2E test — it covers the entire cashier revenue flow

frontend_unit.description: Cart Zustand store: addItem() appends product with quantity 1; duplicate increments quantity
Cart Zustand store: removeItem() removes product from cart; clearCart() empties all
Cart total displayed in VNĐ format matches sum of (unitPriceVnd × quantity)
useOrders hook: fetches paginated order list; applies status filter correctly
ConfirmPaymentModal: shows totalVnd and payment method selector; submits correct payload
